page_title: TOR 0-3 INT | Torino v Inter 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Carlos Augusto (Inter) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+5' 0 - 3 Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) confidently powers his spot-kick into the left side of the goal.
90+3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+3' One of the Torino players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Inter have been awarded a penalty kick!
90+2' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Matteo Darmian is replaced by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' A cross from Antonio Sanabria (Torino) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
88' Torino are seeing far more of the ball now.
86' Ivan Juric has decided to make a change. Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) replaces Karol Linetty.
86' Ivan Ilic (Torino) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Valentino Lazaro.
85' The resulting corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) comes to nothing.
85' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Torino will take a corner kick.
83' The ratio of the ball possession is 44:56.
82' The referee signals a substitution. Davy Klaassen (Inter) is brought on as a substitute for Lautaro Martinez.
80' Karol Linetty (Torino) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
78' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
78' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
77' A great run by Marcus Thuram (Inter) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
77' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
77' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar.
76' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner.
74' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Pietro Pellegri will be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
74' It will be a substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Demba Seck walks off.
72' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) commits a foul and Matteo Marchetti immediately signals a free kick.
67' 0 - 2 Goal! Francesco Acerbi gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Lautaro Martinez (Inter) glances a header into the net. 0:2.
66' Now Inter have a corner.
66' Davide Frattesi (Inter) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
63' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Matteo Marchetti had a clear view and blows his whistle.
59' 0 - 1 Goal! Denzel Dumfries manages to prod the ball to Marcus Thuram (Inter) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
57' Here is a change. Nicolo Barella is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Davide Frattesi (Inter).
57' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denzel Dumfries (Inter) replacing Benjamin Pavard.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Dimarco leaves the pitch and Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes on.
56' Nicolo Barella (Inter) tries to find Lautaro Martinez, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
53' A mistake by a defender gifts Lautaro Martinez (Inter) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes well wide of the right post.
51' Ivan Juric is forced to make a change. Perr Schuurs is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Saba Sazonov (Torino).
49' Nicolo Barella (Inter) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
49' Perr Schuurs (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
47' Samuele Ricci (Torino) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Yann Sommer into a superb diving save to keep it out.
42' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a throw-in.
40' Demba Seck (Torino) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
35' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
35' Demba Seck (Torino) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the left side of the goal. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
34' Marcus Thuram (Inter) meets a cross from Federico Dimarco, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the right post.
32' Samuele Ricci (Torino) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer was alert and made a comfortable save.
31' The referee blows his whistle after Valentino Lazaro (Torino) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. A free kick to Inter.
28' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) executes a long-range free kick. His well-taken effort flies only inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day.
28' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and signals a foul after Demba Seck (Torino) brought his opponent down. A free kick is awarded to Inter.
26' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
25' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Adrien Tameze (Torino) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
20' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.

18' Marcus Thuram (Inter) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom right corner, but it wasn't dangerous and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic made a comfortable save.
17' A cross into the box from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is cleared.
16' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
12' Torino are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
10' A crossfield pass from Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
10' A free kick from long distance is going to be taken by Inter.
7' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
5' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Torino will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Matteo Marchetti.
